svg.title: How the budget lab raises a cost alert
svg.desc: A budget on the resource group tracks monthly cost against the amount you set. When actual cost reaches 50, 80 and 100 percent of the budget, or the forecast goes above 100 percent, the budget sends an email to up to five addresses. An alert does not stop or change any resource.
svg.text: Monthly, with the amount you set
An alert only sends a message. It does not stop or change any resource.
